neighbours.label: the determiner or possessive inside an idiom of whose side, interests or authority something serves ('in their favor', 'best interests at heart', 'with the consent of the')
fire: After the recount, the result finally turned in our favor.
The judge said she had the children's best interests at heart.
The new tax was imposed without the consent of the colonists.
Public opinion swung sharply in his favor after the debate.
Every parent believes they act in their child's best interests.
The treaty was signed with the approval of the Senate.
Momentum shifted in their favor during the second half.
The council acted with the blessing of the local residents.
quiet: After the recount, the result was finally announced on Monday.
The judge said she had read the children's letters at home.
The new tax was imposed on the sugar shipped to the colonists.
Public opinion was measured weekly by phone after the debate.
Every parent remembers their child's first day at school.
The treaty was signed in the great hall of the Senate.
Rain started falling heavily during the second half.
The council met in the library with the local residents.
